title: JARA Portal Action
description: Schema for a single action definition in actions.json

id.description: Unique action identifier used in routes

name.description: Human-readable action name shown in the Portal UI

description.description: Short summary of what the action does

lifecycle.description: service = runs until manually stopped; portal shows a start/stop toggle with probed status

stopConfirmMessage.description: Confirmation prompt shown before stopping (service actions)

commands.description: One-shot: the run steps. Service: the START steps.

stop_commands.description: Service only: steps run when stopping.

status_command.description: Service only: probe. Exit 0 = running, non-zero = stopped.

probe_interval.description: Optional per-action probe interval in seconds

run_on.description: Where to run: 'host' runs directly on macOS via SSH, 'container' (default) runs inside code-server
